Name: Prerequisites: Enable Bedrock + AgentCore + model access
Description: Enable Bedrock AgentCore access, Claude Sonnet + Nova Lite model access, AgentCore Gateway quota in AWS console

Name: Prerequisites: Docker Desktop + CDK + AWS CLI
Description: Ensure Docker Desktop running, aws-cdk v2 installed (npm install -g aws-cdk), AWS CLI configured with deploy permissions

Name: Prerequisites: Slack webhook URL for alerts
Description: Create Slack workspace/channel, generate webhook URL for alert testing

Name: Clone repo and verify dev environment
Description: git clone https://github.com/vandy1311/connect-analytics-platform.git — pip install -r requirements-dev.txt — pytest tests/ (88 tests pass)

Name: Review synthetic data generator + run locally
Description: Review scripts/generate_synthetic_data.py — run python scripts/generate_synthetic_data.py — verify output/ has CTR (Parquet), Agent Events (Parquet), Contact Lens (JSON)

Name: Review Glue table definitions
Description: Review connect_analytics_cdk/glue_tables.py — verify schemas match design doc — partition projection configured

Name: Review data stack (S3 + Glue + Athena)
Description: Review connect_analytics_cdk/stacks/data_stack.py — S3 bucket, Glue DB, Athena workgroup

Name: Upload synthetic data to S3
Description: Run synthetic data generator — upload output/ to s3://connect-analytics-demo/ with correct partition structure

Name: Validate Athena queries against synthetic data
Description: Run validation query from impl plan in Athena console — Billing queue should show ~12 min avg wait and ~14% abandonment

Name: Review shared utility modules
Description: Review lambda_tools/shared/ — athena_client.py, error_handler.py, circuit_breaker.py, alert_publisher.py

Name: Review get_queue_health tool
Description: Review lambda_tools/supervisor/get_queue_health.py — verify SQL, response structure, circuit breaker usage

Name: Review get_abandonment_analysis tool
Description: Review lambda_tools/supervisor/get_abandonment_analysis.py — two queries (aggregation + peak hour)

Name: Review get_agent_utilization tool
Description: Review lambda_tools/supervisor/get_agent_utilization.py — CTE query, occupancy clamping, status normalization

Name: Review trigger_sla_alert tool
Description: Review lambda_tools/supervisor/trigger_sla_alert.py — threshold lookup, EventBridge publish, severity calc

Name: Verify AgentCore Gateway API availability
Description: Test AgentCore Gateway creation via SDK — this is the #1 risk item. If API not available, need fallback plan

Name: Review Supervisor Agent CDK construct
Description: Review connect_analytics_cdk/agents/supervisor_agent.py — gateway creation, agent config, tool schemas

Name: Review Slack formatter Lambda
Description: Review lambda_tools/alerts/slack_formatter/handler.py — Block Kit formatting, retry logic, channel routing

Name: Review alert stack CDK
Description: Review connect_analytics_cdk/stacks/alert_stack.py — 5 EventBridge rules, 5 SNS topics, Slack Lambda

Name: Test Slack webhook integration end-to-end
Description: Configure SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL — trigger a test SLA_BREACH event — verify Slack message appears in channel

Name: Review get_sentiment_trends tool
Description: Review lambda_tools/quality/get_sentiment_trends.py — sentiment aggregation, matplotlib chart generation

Name: Review get_coaching_recommendations tool
Description: Review lambda_tools/quality/get_coaching_recommendations.py — threshold filtering, excerpt fetching, suggestion generation

Name: Review get_compliance_violations tool
Description: Review lambda_tools/quality/get_compliance_violations.py — flag parsing, high-severity alert publishing

Name: Review Quality Agent CDK construct
Description: Review connect_analytics_cdk/agents/quality_agent.py — Claude Sonnet, 3 tools, shared gateway reference

Name: Review get_staffing_forecast tool
Description: Review lambda_tools/wfm/get_staffing_forecast.py — volume patterns, confidence intervals, area chart

Name: Review get_burnout_signals tool
Description: Review lambda_tools/wfm/get_burnout_signals.py — burnout score formula, trend detection, alert publishing

Name: Review WFM Agent CDK construct
Description: Review connect_analytics_cdk/agents/wfm_agent.py — Nova Lite, 2 tools, shared gateway reference

Name: Review Nova Sonic voice module
Description: Review lambda_tools/shared/voice_client.py — Bedrock InvokeModel, graceful fallback, latency warning

Name: Test Nova Sonic voice synthesis
Description: Test synthesize_speech() with a sample agent response — verify audio bytes returned — check latency < 3s

Name: Review auth middleware
Description: Review lambda_tools/shared/auth.py — token validation, RBAC enforcement, audit logging

Name: Review auth stack CDK
Description: Review connect_analytics_cdk/stacks/auth_stack.py — API key config, role mapping, demo tokens

Name: Review agent stack CDK
Description: Review connect_analytics_cdk/stacks/agent_stack.py — DockerImageFunction, gateway, 3 agents, IAM policies

Name: Review CDK app entry point + wiring
Description: Review connect_analytics_cdk/app.py — stack dependencies, cross-stack refs, CfnOutputs

Name: Run cdk synth and fix any errors
Description: cd connect_analytics_cdk && cdk synth — verify CloudFormation template generated without errors

Name: Run cdk deploy to Isengard account
Description: cdk deploy --all — target ~8 min deploy — verify all resources created

Name: Demo dry-run: Query 1 — queue health
Description: 'Show me queue health right now' → Billing queue 12 min wait, SLA breach, 14% abandonment

Name: Demo dry-run: Query 2 — abandonment spike
Description: 'Why did abandonment spike at 2pm?' → 2 agents on break, 96% occupancy

Name: Demo dry-run: Query 3 — live Slack alert
Description: Verify SLA breach alert fires in Slack during queue health query

Name: Demo dry-run: Query 4 — coaching recommendations
Description: 'Which agents need coaching this week?' → Agent-017: 4 negative calls, interruption pattern

Name: Demo dry-run: Query 5 — worst call transcript
Description: 'Show me the worst call' → Transcript + sentiment chart

Name: Demo dry-run: Query 6 — staffing forecast
Description: 'Forecast staffing for next Monday' → 340 contacts 10am-2pm, need 22, have 18 + chart

Name: Demo dry-run: Query 7 — burnout signals
Description: 'Any agents showing burnout signals?' → Agent-023/031: >92% occupancy for 8 days

Name: Demo dry-run: Query 8 — live cdk deploy
Description: Live cdk deploy during demo — stack deploys in ~8 min

Name: Fix any failing demo queries
Description: If any demo response doesn't match script — fix synthetic data patterns first, then agent logic

Name: Final rehearsal — full 5-min demo run
Description: Complete end-to-end demo with all 3 speakers — time it — verify all 8 queries + Slack alert

Name: Submit hackathon entry
Description: Submit final hackathon deliverables by deadline
